Hi Helen — thanks for the packet, received and skimmed. Looping in Vanessa (networking & deploy contracts) and Karthik (priv infra / module stewardship) who will own the technical review.

Preliminary notes and proposed next steps:

1) KMS envelope + TF state: we prefer customer-managed KMS keys for private deployments when customers need key separation. We can integrate with your KMS (cross-account policy + key grant) or use Redwood-managed keys if you want us to rotate; call out which you prefer.

2) Secret rotation cadence: 30 days is reasonable for long-lived DB creds; for runtime ephemeral tokens we recommend 7-14 days or on-demand short-lived STS tokens. We'll propose a lease table and CronJob cadence in the TF modules.

3) Helm contract: Vanessa — can you validate the clauses around immutable values and image pinning? We should also add a CI gate that rejects charts with :latest or floating tags.

Propose a 30-min review: Mon 2025-08-11 10:00-10:30 PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Attaching internal checklist: see Confluence link (will share below).

- Rachel

Thanks Rachel / Helen — quick technical notes from the Helm & deployment contracts perspective:

- Helm values diff: the chart contract should declare which values are 'operator-managed' vs 'customer-manageable'. For operator-managed values (e.g., serviceAccountName, imagePullSecrets) we include an override whitelist.

- Image pinning: We require immutable digests for production releases. CI step suggestion: a pre-apply job (helm lint + digest-resolve) that fails the pipeline if non-digested images are present. I'll add a sample GitLab job to our module repo.

- Secrets: prefer sealed-secrets or SOPS for values.yaml secrets at rest in Git. For runtime, route to a secrets-agent that pulls from your KMS-backed vault and caches per-pod with TTL.

- Rotation: propose the following concrete plan for TF modules:
  * vault_secret resource + rotation Lambda/Cron that rotates DB creds every 30 days by default.
  * ephemeral runtime tokens minted for 12-hour leases for the runtime process.
  * TF variable 'secret_rotation_mode' with values {managed_by_redwood, customer_kms} and module tests.

I'll attach a small draft of the chart-policy (text) and the CI snippet after this message.

Related link: JIRA-RINF-1127 (I'll create a subtask for the CI job).

- Vanessa

Adding a few infra-specific caveats from module ownership / networking side:

- Bastion / jump host: For initial rollout we allow a hardened bastion with MFA and short SSH certs. Long term we prefer a jumpless SSM-based access pattern. TF modules will expose a 'bastion_mode' toggle and enforce security group narrowness.

- Service accounts / IAM roles: modules will produce stable role names and an allow-listing pattern so Redis/Metrics agents can assume roles only via token exchange. Avoid embedding roles in Helm values; instead, reference role ARNs injected by the module.

- CI/CD: we should require terraform plan diffs to include a redwood-scan step that checks for any newly introduced plaintext secrets and for KMS policy changes.

- Helm chart contract clause suggestion: add a requirement that owners pin minor+patch versions (e.g., 1.4.x) and we run canary deploys with automatic rollback on readiness failures. This prevents silent drift from upstream chart changes.

I can draft exact TF variable names and policy snippets overnight; I'll attach them to the Jira ticket.

— Karthik
